title: LuckRead D1-04 W07 Refunds and Billing Documents PostgreSQL Schema Slice

dependencies.sourceBoundary: Refunds are Hyperswitch-only and must not alter the RevenueCat inbox or payment_provider_events provider constraint. Billing documents are immutable W07 snapshots bound to their authoritative Order and, for receipts, a succeeded Payment.

refunds.remainingRefundRule: Sum every existing refund for the same payment except FAILED; reject a new amount above captured amount minus that sum.

billing_documents.snapshot: Bounded valid JSON text, immutable after issue.
billing_documents.sourceGuard: Every document matches authoritative Order customer/currency/total; RECEIPT additionally matches a succeeded Payment for the same Order/customer/currency/amount.
billing_documents.retention: Issued billing documents are immutable and retained.

postgresMappings.integer: Map D1/SQLite integer identifiers, versions and money-minor values to BIGINT; preserve source safe-integer bounds for amounts.
postgresMappings.time: Map ISO-8601 TEXT instants to TIMESTAMPTZ and compare provider update timestamps as instants.
postgresMappings.json: Keep snapshot_json as TEXT with a PostgreSQL JSONB parse check and the source 65,536-character maximum; preserve all valid JSON value types.
postgresMappings.relationships: Use source-semantic trigger checks against existing orders/payments; add zero foreign keys and no new ownership domain.
postgresMappings.refundProvider: Refund records remain HyperSwitch-only; external provider calls remain outside database transactions and only verified provider events may advance provider-confirmed state.
postgresMappings.refundConcurrency: Lock the matched payment row before calculating remaining refundable amount so concurrent refund inserts for one payment serialize.
postgresMappings.billing: INVOICE has no payment_id; RECEIPT requires the same succeeded payment and exact amount/currency/order/customer snapshot.
postgresMappings.authority: W07 remains sole D1-04 finance authority; D1-01 continues to own subscription entitlements.

requiredPositiveCases: refund insert matches a succeeded/partially-captured HyperSwitch payment and available captured amount
remaining refundable amount decreases by every non-FAILED refund
refund lifecycle follows allowed monotonic transitions and version CAS
invoice matches order and has no payment_id
receipt matches the same succeeded payment/order/customer/currency/amount
requiredNegativeCases: refund for another customer/order/merchant/provider/payment is rejected
captured amount greater than payment amount is rejected
refund amount greater than remaining captured amount is rejected
customer-scoped idempotency key reuse is rejected
illegal refund state transition is rejected
version must advance exactly one and updated_at must increase
billing document for unknown or mismatched order is rejected
receipt without a matching succeeded payment is rejected
issued billing documents cannot be updated or deleted
refund financial facts cannot be deleted
noRemoteOperations: no Worker deployment or binding change

nextGate: PAY-007 payment-method revocation PostgreSQL 18 local rehearsal only. Shared-ledger remote runner and Neon cutover remain unauthorized.
